entities.name: Short MAC
entities.description: A type 3 information element with length of 3 octets that protects the integrity of a SERVICE REQUEST message by including the 2 least significant octets of the message authentication code.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: The message whose integrity is protected by the Short MAC information element. The integrity protection includes octet 1 and 2 of this message.

entities.name: Short MAC IEI
entities.description: Short MAC information element identifier field occupying bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Short MAC value
entities.description: Contains the 2 least significant octets of the message authentication code calculated for the SERVICE REQUEST message. Bits 4-1 of octet 1 and bits 8-1 of octet 2-3 contain this value.

entities.name: Integrity protection algorithm
entities.description: The algorithm used to calculate the message authentication code for integrity protection of the SERVICE REQUEST message, as specified in clause 9.5.

relations.description: The Short MAC information element provides integrity protection for the SERVICE REQUEST message.
The Short MAC information element contains the Short MAC IEI identifier field.
The Short MAC information element contains the Short MAC value field.
The Short MAC value is calculated using the integrity protection algorithm specified in clause 9.5.
The Short MAC information element is defined for use in the SERVICE REQUEST message.
